question: Q2: necessity: why not skip rounds backwards
number: The inverse S-box is x^e with e = 5^-1 mod (p-1) = (4(p-1)+1)/5 (checked), e/(p-1) = 0.8: a dense polynomial of degree about 0.8p. Backward the S-box is full-size, not degree 5, so there is no cheap backward skip; the forward degree 5^k grows slowly, which is why only forward skipping works.
